- Preprocess the Data

In that case, we will removed the inputs Open, High, Low, Adjusted and prepared a new categrorical input to change the data from fitting a regression problem to a classification problem.

source("scripts/prep.r")
## [1] "Post-Subsetted values"

## 2016-07-15 719.85 1279300   Down
## 2016-07-18 733.78 1295500     Up

After preprocessing the original data, our prep data contains the following variables: close, volume, target
